additional_info.subject: Customer Query
additional_info.body: In the outlet on the right, the error flag 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' is set after a few minutes of charging. The cause is a temperature difference between the DC+ and DC- contact in the CCS connector of greater than 15° Celsius. Confirmed by measuring the truck inlet. The investigation was carried out here with L3 support and a replacement of the contacts was recommended.
